what: Section X.2 of the research protocol: the sources this archive leans on, as a graph of domains, so that section I.6 can be answered -- which of them are INDEPENDENT witnesses and which merely repeat another. Built from fields the archive already holds; nothing here was fetched to make it.
rule: An edge is a thing somebody recorded, never an inference from a shared subject. Every edge names the field it was read out of in its basis, and every node says what classified it. A host the archive cannot classify is emitted as unclassified and counted, because leaving it out would read as a clean answer.
how_to_read_it: rel discovered_record_on and discovery_step come from discovery_path, which records the surface a record was found on. rel links_to is the only edge read from a page BODY rather than from a field. rel byte_identical_body and same_work_also_at are the mirroring findings: two names, one witness. rel alias_of is the same host under a www prefix. rel redirects_to is a source_url that landed elsewhere.
